# Starling Bank

> > Award-winning digital bank offering personal and business accounts with innovative features like Spaces, Bills Manager, Spending Intelligence, and Kite debit cards for kids.

Starling Bank is a UK-based mobile-first bank providing personal banking services including savings accounts (Fixed Saver, Easy Saver, Flexible Cash ISA), budgeting tools, virtual cards, and business banking solutions. The bank emphasizes AI-powered financial insights and peer-to-peer payment capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Spaces (savings pots)
- Bills Manager
- Spending Intelligence (AI insights)
- Kite (kids banking)
- Fixed Saver
- Easy Saver
- Flexible Cash ISA
- Settle Up (peer-to-peer payments)
- Virtual cards
- Apple Pay and Google Pay
- Business accounts
- Budgeting tools
- Scam protection
- Digital wallet integration

## Core Banking Services

- [Starling | Award-winning bank accounts](https://www.starlingbank.com/): Homepage for Starling Bank's personal & business banking with Spaces & Kite

## Money Transfer & Payments

- [Settle Up with Starling Bank](https://settleup.starlingbank.com/): Peer-to-peer money transfer using card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay
